Cancún Challenge Mayan Division champions |tourney=[[2022 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] |tourney_result=runner-up }} {{2021–22 Conference USA men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team''' represented [[Middle Tennessee State University]] during the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by fourth-year head coach [[Nick McDevitt]], and played their home games at [[Murphy Center]] in [[Murfreesboro, Tennessee]] as members of [[Conference USA]] (C-USA). == Previous season == In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders men's basketball team|Blue Raiders]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 5–18, 3–13 in C-USA play, to finish in sixth place in East Division.{{Cite web |title=2020-21 Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders Schedule and Results |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/cbb/schools/middle-tennessee/2021-schedule.html |access-date=2021-11-12 |website=Sports-Reference.com}} In the first round of the [[2021 Conference USA men's basketball tournament|C-USA tournament]], the Blue Raiders advanced to the second round when [[2020–21 FIU Panthers men's basketball team|FIU]] was forced to withdraw due to positive COVID-19 tests.{{Cite web |last=Gibson |first=Richard |date=2021-03-09 |title=Breaking News: FIU Men's Basketball Out Of C-USA Tournament |url=https://panthernow.com/2021/03/09/breaking-news-fiu-mens-basketball-out-of-c-usa-tournament/ |access-date=2024-10-21 |website=PantherNOW |language=en-US}} In the second round, they lost to [[2020–21 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|North Texas]].{{Cite web|title=Middle Tennessee vs. North Texas - Game Summary - March 10, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401301264|access-date=2021-11-12|website=ESPN.com|language=en}} ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
